mods.name: Did That Hurt?
mods.description: Did That Hurt? is a minimalist Minecraft-style damage HUD mod. When you take damage, the HUD shows the damage value, attack source, and optional damage breakdown in real time, helping you quickly understand how hard the hit was, whether it is time to run, and how big the power gap is between you and your opponent.
